entries.text: Grandpa, I’m home![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_01

entries.text: Welcome home, Kieran. And who’s this with you?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, um... This is [VAR 0x0100(0000)]... [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s part
of
the
same
school
trip as me and Sis.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_02

entries.text: Oho! So this is a new friend of yours, eh, Kieran?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_02

entries.text: I sure am!
entries.label: sdc01_0110_select_01

entries.text: I’d say so
entries.label: sdc01_0110_select_02

entries.text: What?! R-really?! We’re friends?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_03

entries.text: F-friends... I feel all tingly and funny hearing\nthat... Ehehe...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thank you for befriending our Kieran here,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_03

entries.text: Oh? Kieran’s made a friend?[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)], this is my grandma.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_06

entries.text: Well, fancy that! A friend of Kieran’s! We’re\ndelighted to have you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_02

entries.text: Oh, my, is it really already sundown?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_04

entries.text: Goodness me, I’d nearly forgotten. The Festival\nof Masks starts tonight, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_03

entries.text: Come now, Kieran. You too, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_04

entries.text: I’ll get out some jinbei for you both so you can\ngo to the festival all gussied up.[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_05

entries.text: Hear that? We get to dress up in jinbei! Yay![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_07

entries.text: [EMPTY 42]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_06

entries.text: [EMPTY 42]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_select_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 42]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_select_04

entries.text: Now, now, don’t go running off just yet—we have\nto do up your hair, too![VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_07

entries.text: There we are. All done![VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_08

entries.text: It suits you mighty fine. Just as I thought it would![VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_13

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Goodness, it’s like I’ve gained another\ngrand[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0803)]sondaughter!\r\nHoho![VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_05

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I imagine a stylish young thing like yourself could\nmake good use of this too,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_09

entries.text: Having that card should open up all sorts of new\nlooks for you at the big-city shops and salons.[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_10

entries.text: Hey, Gran, d’you know where my—?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_sister_01

entries.text: Gah! What’re YOU doing here?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_sister_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] said...[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’d go to the
Festival
of
Masks
with
me...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_09

entries.text: Oh, really? Is that so...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_sister_03

entries.text: What’s it matter anyway! What’re YOU doin’\nback here?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_10

entries.text: Oh, right. Gran, I couldn’t find my mask for the\nfestival.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_sister_04

entries.text: Oh, the masks? They should be in the shed.\nI put them there after last year’s festival.[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_11

entries.text: It shouldn’t be locked, so you three can go have\na rummage and see what you find.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_06

entries.text: All right! To the shed! First one there wins![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_sister_05

entries.text: Wait—Sis! You’re such a cheater![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_brother_11

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Please forgive those two,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
They
can
be
a
bit
rambunctious.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_07

entries.text: I do hope you’ll keep being friends with my\ngrandchildren.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gfather_08

entries.text: The masks should be in the garden shed. I hope\nyou all have a good time together.[VAR 0x0114(0037)]
entries.label: sdc01_0110_gmother_12

entries.text: Have you seen Carmine?\c\nWe were heading to one of those signboards\nwhen she just up and disappeared...
